params.sample_date_rule: For each of the 6 metadata sample months, take the date nearest mid-month (day 15) with at least 80% of that month's maximum quote count in data/clean/options_io.csv.
params.svi_form: a+b*(rho*(k-m)+sqrt((k-m)^2+eta^2)); b=softplus(u), rho=tanh(v), eta=softplus(s), a,m free
params.svi_solver_protocol: torch Adam then L-BFGS (float64) vs scipy least_squares, both from the same full-sample SVI start (approach1 raw fit when available)
params.svi_robustness: refit by one bounded least_squares from the full-sample SVI warm start (multi-start fallback if missing)

neural_architecture.inputs: k/0.2, sqrt(T)/sqrt(max T on sample date)

params.neural_loss: mean((C_BS(sigma)-C_mkt)^2) in undiscounted OTM price per unit forward, plus lambda1*mean(max(0,-g)^2) + lambda2*mean(max(0,-dw/dT)^2) on a collocation grid k in [-0.14,0.14] crossed with T spanning the listed expiries; g includes +w''/2. The whole objective (fit plus penalties) is multiplied by c = 1/initial price loss; lambda is unchanged, so the minimizer is mathematically unchanged.

objective_scaling.constant: c = 1 / initial_price_loss, computed per fit from the shared initialization
objective_scaling.applies_to: fit term and both penalty terms (whole objective)

params.selection_rule: Choose the lambda pair with complete fit coverage, then zero butterfly and calendar violations at 1e-8 on the approach1 audit grid (strict counts included), then the smallest pooled in-sample OTM relative repricing median; break ties by the smallest lambda1 + lambda2, then by (lambda1, lambda2). If no pair has complete coverage and zero violations, minimize failed fits, then total violations, then repricing error. Only in-sample ablation data are used; robustness holdouts are never used for selection.
params.price_note: CFFEX fields: settle=今结算, close=今收盘; no settlement algorithm is inferred.
params.rate_convention: reused from approach1 (SHIBOR ACT/360 simple converted to continuous zero on ACT/365)
params.forward_estimator: reused from approach1 (volume-weighted parity forward within |ln(F_K/median)| <= 0.05)

worker_isolation.method: spawn one fresh process per neural fit

params.seed_derivation: sha256(base_seed|date|design|rep) mod (2^31-1); independent of lambda, explicit per fit; all lambda pairs on a date share one initialization

filter_removals.note: Reused approach1 filters: volume>=min_volume, price>=min_price, |k|<=kband, days>=min_days.

otm.note: OTM definition and IV inversion reused from approach1; expiries with fewer than min_strikes OTM quotes are dropped.

svi_solver.protocol: Both solvers start from the same full-sample SVI parameters: approach1 raw fit from results/approach1/io/svi_params.csv when available, otherwise a computed multi-start fit.

start_info.note: Both solvers start from the same full-sample SVI parameters: approach1's best raw fit when available, otherwise a local multi-start fit.

ablation.selection_rule: Choose the lambda pair with complete fit coverage, then zero butterfly and calendar violations at 1e-8 on the approach1 audit grid (strict counts included), then the smallest pooled in-sample OTM relative repricing median; break ties by the smallest lambda1 + lambda2, then by (lambda1, lambda2). If no pair has complete coverage and zero violations, minimize failed fits, then total violations, then repricing error. Only in-sample ablation data are used; robustness holdouts are never used for selection.

robustness.design_note: random drops 30% of quotes per sample date using 3 seeds; wing holds out the outer 15% of |k| within each expiry. Both models are refit on the remaining quotes and scored only on held-out quotes. Expiries with fewer than min_strikes training quotes, or where SVI fit failed, are excluded from both models. SVI refits are warm-started from the full-sample approach1 fit when available; neural refits are fresh spawned fits with explicit seeds. Pooled summaries cover successful fits only.

dense_grid.T: listed expiries plus midpoints between adjacent expiries

violations.note: Approach1-grid violations at each listed expiry; dense-grid violations use k in [-0.20,0.20] step 0.005 and listed expiries plus midpoints. Calendar compares adjacent T grid points.

comparison_approach1.basis: approach1 repaired SVI parameters from svi_params.csv, re-priced on this run's OTM quote set

determinism_check.note: Two fresh spawned fits with the same explicit seed. A nonzero difference is reported as nondeterminism for AGENTS.md rule 3.

runtime.note: fit_seconds covers SVI solver comparison, neural ablation and robustness refits; total_seconds is wall time for the whole run.

determinism_check.note: Two fresh spawned fits with the same explicit seed. A nonzero difference is reported as nondeterminism for AGENTS.md rule 3.

rates.convention: simple ACT/360 SHIBOR converted to continuous zero rate on ACT/365 T (reused from approach1)
